scenarios.title: Source guard parses under Bash 3 and Bash 5

plannedTests.testId: Regression: SCN-B043-001 repaired guard parses under real Bash 3 and Bash 5 on identical bytes

obligations.requiredProof: Freeze one canonical guard hash and assert the real Bash 3.2 and Bash 5.3 parser boundary against those exact bytes.
Prove producer parser parity and the current command consumer surface against the same canonical guard bytes.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Restore only the two redundant outer assignment quotes exactly once in a private source-derived copy. Bash 3.2 must reject that copy before the sentinel.

scenarios.liveExpectation: One frozen repaired-source hash produces Bash 3.2 exit 0 and Bash 5.3 exit 0 through the real parser binaries.

liveProofNotApplicable.reason: Parser compatibility is a framework command property with no rendered product surface.

scenarios.title: The regression rejects the incompatible grammar

plannedTests.testId: Regression: SCN-B043-002 source-derived fixture crosses the former Bash 3 recovery boundary
Mutation: SCN-B043-002 exact outer-quote restoration recreates the parser divergence

obligations.requiredProof: Execute a fixture derived from unique current-source anchors through both real parsers and assert the post-boundary sentinel.
Prove repaired-versus-mutant parser parity and the post-boundary command output visible to the current consumer surface.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Restore only the opening and closing outer quotes around the Check 7C assignment exactly once. Preserve the apostrophe and every executable heredoc byte.

scenarios.liveExpectation: The repaired Bash 3.2 and Bash 5.3 fixtures each parse with exit 0 and emit one BUG043_SENTINEL_AFTER_FORMER_LINE_4016. The quote-restoration mutant yields parse exits 2 and 0 with sentinel counts 0 and 1.

liveProofNotApplicable.reason: The adversarial check validates shell grammar rather than a rendered surface.

scenarios.title: Supported-runtime guard behavior remains stable

plannedTests.testId: Regression: SCN-B043-003 supported-runtime transition verdicts remain unchanged
Regression: BUG-043 framework validation and release readiness preserve parser and propagation contracts

obligations.requiredProof: Execute the real transition guard selftest path under supported Bash and preserve every existing verdict and applicability result.
Prove the guard owner and aggregate framework consumers observe unchanged transition semantics.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Alter the repaired branch outcome. An existing transition fixture must detect the semantic drift.

scenarios.liveExpectation: The complete supported-Bash transition guard selftest and both aggregate CLI checks exit zero without a skipped check or changed verdict.

liveProofNotApplicable.reason: Transition policy is a repository guard result with no rendered product surface.

scenarios.title: Downstream installation receives the repaired guard

plannedTests.testId: Regression: SCN-B043-004 installed transition guard matches source bytes and parser parity

obligations.requiredProof: Generate the release manifest, install into a private downstream fixture, and execute the real parser boundary against installed bytes.
Prove source-to-installed byte parity and the current installed command surface without direct downstream edits.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Install a manifest with the old guard checksum. Byte parity or the parser matrix must fail.

scenarios.liveExpectation: The canonical generator and installer produce an installed guard with the source SHA-256, and both real parser legs exit zero on that copy.

liveProofNotApplicable.reason: Installer propagation is a repository artifact contract with no rendered product surface.
